title: From Personalization to Prejudice: Bias and Discrimination in Memory-Enhanced AI Agents for Recruitment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating positional attention and Meritocratic (Un)Fairness of retrieved and re-ranked candidate lists for male and female groups using the Bias in Bios dataset, across varying memory and personalization configurations of a simulated AI recruitment agent (including tests with explicitly gender-scrubbed profiles).
